title: Belgium: flat long run, THE FUELLING TEST
terrain: flat outdoor, Belgium, no vertical available
coachNotes: THIS IS THE FUELLING SESSION, not the running session. Belgium is flat and there is no vertical to chase, so the only thing this day can teach you is whether 60 g/h goes down while you are working. 22 August returned 21-29 g/h and a happy stomach, which proved nothing because the gut was never asked a question. FEED EVERY 30 MINUTES FROM MINUTE 30, carbohydrate in the bottle, 60 g/h measured not estimated. Write down grams, product, and what the stomach did in the last 30 minutes. If 60 is uncomfortable here, at 1h45 and flat, then 60 will not survive hour six at Pirin and we need to know that on 29 August and not on 5 September. Sodium 500-700 mg/h, which was missing entirely on 22 August. Pace is irrelevant today.
